description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Core Prowler, adding {C}{C}.
Core Prowler dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Core Prowler trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Core Prowler from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
